LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: All-Around Helper
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: All-Around Helper (T-05-41) is a spherical housekeeping robot that interprets bloodstains as dust to be scrubbed.\nWhen breached, it revs up its hidden buzzsaws and launches blinding charge dashes across corridors.
